description: ADO-BATCH-SCOPE Update Resync: for each value 0, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 15 of the Recordset property "Update Resync" (set after Open, read back) on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (read/write copy), AddNew with Code "r<value>" and S "ins", Update, read the new row's ID, UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) and the Errors, then read the new row's ID, Status and S, and Close; finally the stored rows through Execute. Asks which values make the generated key and server-side values visible in the cached row.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
